classification.difficultyReason: Interpret equal-offset ticks to subtract two 3 cm offsets from the 16 cm span, then use the resulting missing parallel side and supplied height in the trapezium formula.

content.prompt: Find the area of this trapezium.

spec.description: Inverted trapezium with parallel-side arrows, a 16 cm upper side, red dashed external height and offset guides, a 7 cm vertical separation, and equal double-ticked horizontal offsets with the right offset labelled 3 cm.
spec.mathematics: The equal offsets are each 3 cm, so the lower parallel side is 16−3−3=10 cm. The perpendicular height is 7 cm.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and construction marks are visible; the inferred 10 cm side and area are answer-only.

answer.worked:
The matching ticks show that both horizontal offsets are $3\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}b&=16-3-3=10\text{ cm}\\A&=\frac{h(a+b)}{2}\\A&=\frac{7(16+10)}{2}\\A&=91\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
